create_past_job: create a past job record in MongoDB with dataset name, start time, and finish time, returning whether the dataset was rate-limited
create_PastJobDocument: create a PastJobDocument mongoengine model with dataset, duration, and finished_at fields for tracking completed job durations
create_QuerySetManager: create a QuerySetManager generic descriptor that provides typed QuerySet access on mongoengine Document classes
create_rate_limit_check: create a rate-limiting check that blocks datasets exceeding total compute duration within a sliding time window
create_TTL_index: create a TTL index on the finished_at field to automatically expire past job records after the rate-limit window
